scope: Seven explicit grouped follow-up categories; not an exhaustive unique-file dependency count. Per-source wording in COVERAGE remains authoritative.

groups.dependency: Separately stored source programs and historical test/count/timing claims need exact-hash static mapping and independently authored behavioral checks before stronger implementation acceptance. Some exact files may already have separate reviews; this is not a declaration that all referenced code is unread.

Preserve word width, common input scale, eager table construction, capped randomness, precision and output contract. Accepted source algebra does not certify a faithful full executor or every shrinking-error composition.

Pinned thin-matrix or external compiler theorem, carrier/frame schedule, dirty scratch, uniform printable DAG, all-length reduction and actual coefficient/routing costs. h24 arithmetic/exponent controls alone do not close this interface.

Examples include explicit F8 raw-scan realization, F32 minor, N8 degree/Jacobian/dynamic certificates, and source Bareiss network objects. Their source summary and current independently checked lemmas must not be conflated.

Actual fast local blocks, transparent full-state replay, charged effective scheduler and coefficient/root generation. Reviewed padding and orientation repairs are necessary bookkeeping, not a new completed fast family.
Only explicitly cited primary checks in the helper review are accepted here. Historical changing exponent, prior-art, commit, package-coverage and priority statements need their own exact references.
Full tensor-Weil research and checkpoint texts are absent from the frozen recovered inventory. Available companions and narrow independent structural results do not substitute for them.
